summary: Grilled the FORGE-BOARD-3 simplification plan against the traceable-board spec and active decisions. Small and clean: one code change (--ac conditional on --no-spec) plus two doc rewords (stories-only mirror, degraded-mode pr-link fallback). Mechanics maps confirmed task-state mirroring is docs-only and pr-link demotion touches no test. Decision 0014's spec-debt planning gate is preserved. Three design choices settled in one round.
resolutions: --ac on --no-spec: optional-but-accepted (not rejected) — keeps existing tests green and satisfies the spec by not REQUIRING acceptance criteria at capture.
Story shape: one cohesive leaf task/PR (code + docs), not split into two stories — the facets are tiny; one task has one scope, sidestepping the split rule sensibly.
Kind: keep --kind refactor and decide the source-delta ratchet at pr_ready with the measured delta; switch to feature only if it reds.
open_items: Refactor source-delta ratchet may red at pr_ready if test additions tip net factory/scripts delta positive; parked — re-scope kind to feature at pr_ready if it fires.
